CRJU 210.title: Ethics in Criminal Justice

CRJU 312.title: Corrections

CRJU 313.title: Criminal Courts

CRJU 314.title: Criminal Law

CRJU 323.description: Historical overview of violence in American society, including theoretical perspectives on the causes and prevention of violence.

CRJU 351.title: Juvenile Delinquency

CRJU 399.title: Independent Study

CRJU 430.title: Communities and Crime

CRJU 485.title: Selected Topics in Criminal Justice Policy

CRJU 558.title: Crime Over the Life Course

CRJU 563.title: Race, Crime, and Criminal Justice

CRJU 565.description: Origins and modern day activity of organized crime in the United States and internationally will be investigated. Attention is given to problems of criminal activity and the present day transnational character of criminal organizations.

CRJU 582.title: Computer Applications in Criminal Justice

CRJU 591.title: Selected Topics in Criminal Justice

CRJU 701.description: Classical and recent literature in criminal justice. Trends and issues that transcend criminal justice.
CRJU 701.subject: CRJU
CRJU 701.title: Survey of Criminal Justice

CRJU 702.description: Examination of law as an instrument of criminal justice policy, social control, and the protection of civil liberties.

CRJU 791.description: Seminar for advanced students. Topics of current importance, such as drugs, judicial reform, or crime prevention. May be repeated for credit up to 6 semester hours with consent of advisor.
CRJU 791.subject: CRJU
CRJU 791.title: Selected Topics in Criminal Justice

CRJU 814.title: Research Design in Criminology and Criminal Justice

Topics can include analysis of count data, data from randomized field experiments, interrupted time-series studies, longitudinal studies, regression discontinuity studies, instrumental variable estimation, treatment probability matching estimators, statistical power analysis, and study planning.
CRJU 816.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in CRJU 705 and CRJU 812 or equivalents.
